title: Air Ticket Fare Brands: The Lead Traveller's Share of a Party Travel Credit
content:
A fresh travel credit voucher issued under Air Ticket Fare Brands stands in one traveller's name alone. Where the fare brand that produced the lapsed voucher makes travel credits non-transferable, and more than one base-fare line stands on the booking, the value standing is taken at a share, because the fresh voucher stands in the lead traveller's name alone. The party the booking priced is read from the base-fare lines standing on it.

| Travel credits under the fare brand that produced the lapsed voucher | Base-fare lines standing on the booking | What is taken on the value standing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-transferable | Three or more | The value standing is taken at 0.40 |
| Non-transferable | Exactly two | The value standing is taken at 0.60 |
| Any other case | Any number | The value standing is taken in full |

**Both conditions hold together.** A booking carrying four base-fare lines under a fare brand whose travel credits are transferable takes the value standing in full, the first condition being unmet. A booking carrying a single base-fare line under a fare brand whose travel credits are non-transferable also takes the value standing in full, the second being unmet. Three base-fare lines under a fare brand whose travel credits are non-transferable take the value standing at 0.40, and exactly two such lines take it at 0.60.
